verdict.rationale: Pulley documents the individual components — standard option templates (pulley-docs-21), fast 409A valuations to set strike price (pulley-docs-10, pulley-docs-17), equity plan capacity tracking (pulley-docs-23), and compliance/board management support (pulley-docs-19) — but no evidence shows these are stitched into a single guided board-approval-to-grant workflow for issuing options to a new hire. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a board consent/approval step integrated with grant creation, and confirmation that the 409A strike price auto-populates into the option issuance flow.
